## Service Notice
Due to product adjustments, the ParseFace service will no longer accept new user activations starting immediately. Existing users who previously activated this service may continue to use it. ## Feature Description
The ParseFace capability detects a frontal face in the input image and performs pixel-level semantic segmentation on the eyes, nose, and mouth.

> - You can access [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) for live assistance.
- For inquiries regarding API integration, interface usage, or other issues related to visual AI capabilities of the Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, please join our support DingTalk group (23109592) by searching for the group number and contact us.

## Input Restrictions

- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, PNG.
- Image size: No larger than 4 MB.
- Image resolution: Greater than 100×100 pixels and less than 2048×2048 pixels, with an aspect ratio between 0.5 and 2.0.
- The image must contain only one face, which must be frontal and unobstructed by items such as glasses or hats. The facial area must be at least 100×100 pixels, and the detected face bounding box must occupy at least 1/10 of the corresponding image dimension.
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.

SegmentBody.description:
## Feature Description  
The human body segmentation feature detects the human silhouette in the input image and separates it from the background, returning a segmented foreground portrait image with four channels (RGBA). This feature is suitable for real-person photographs and not applicable to cartoon images.  

Example images illustrating this API's functionality are as follows:  

- Input original image  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/uqbc/SegmentBody.png" width="500)  
- Output result image (default is a 4-channel transparent image with resolution identical to the input image)  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/vuji/SegmentBodyjieguo.png" width="500)  

You can pass the **ReturnForm** parameter to specify the format of the returned result:  

- Set to **crop** to crop out blank areas around the edges  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/pfxs/SegmentBodycrop.png" width="500)  
- Set to **mask** to return a binary mask image  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/ltcq/SegmentBodymask.png" width="500)  
- Set to **whiteBK** to return an image with a pure white background  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/qqrj/SegmentBodywhiteBK.png" width="500)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentBody) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API’s vision AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us directly.  

## Common Scenarios  

- **Portrait Photography**: Human body segmentation isolates the subject from the background and applies background blur to simulate a shallow depth-of-field effect typically achieved with a large aperture lens, thereby highlighting the main subject.  

- **Certificate Photo Generation**: By uploading or capturing a casual photo, the system precisely segments the person. Combined with additional background processing capabilities, it can generate standardized certificate photos.  

## Key Advantages  

- **Hair-level Precision Segmentation**: Delivers high segmentation accuracy even in intricate regions such as individual strands of hair, ensuring natural-looking results that are difficult to distinguish as processed.  

- **Robust Performance in Complex Backgrounds**: Accurately segments human figures even when they appear against highly complex backgrounds.

SegmentCloth.title: Clothing Segmentation
SegmentCloth.summary: This topic describes the syntax and examples of SegmentCloth, a clothing segmentation feature.
SegmentCloth.description:
## Feature Description  
The clothing segmentation feature performs pixel-level foreground extraction on the main garments in input images from various scenarios—such as mannequin clothing, real-person clothing, standalone clothing items, and virtual human clothing—and returns the extracted results. This feature focuses on fine-grained segmentation of garments in images. Supported garment categories include outerwear, tops (including linings), pants, skirts, hats, shoes, and bags. For accessories such as belts and ties, we recommend using [Product Segmentation](~~151961~~).  

Example illustrations of this API’s functionality are shown below:  
Input original image (left) and output result image (right):  
- Detected garment categories: tops (tops), skirt (skirts), shoes (shoes)  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/xnvf/SegmentClothtops_skirt_shoes.png" width="400)  
- Detected garment categories: tops (tops), pants (pants), shoes (shoes), bag (bags)  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/hptw/SegmentClothtops_pants_shoes_bag.png" width="400)  
- Detected garment category: hat (hats)  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/guxr/SegmentClothhat.png" width="400)  

You can pass the **ReturnForm** parameter to specify the format of the returned result:  
- Set to **mask** to return a binary mask image.  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/zadd/SegmentClothmask.png" width="400)  
- Set to **whiteBK** to return an image with a pure white background.  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/nwyz/SegmentClothwhiteBK.png" width="400)  
- If no parameter is specified, the system returns an image without a background.  
![](https://help-static-aliyun-doc.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231213/mkru/SegmentCloth.png" width="400)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentCloth) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  
- **E-commerce clothing segmentation**: Foreground segmentation of e-commerce clothing images enables background separation and replacement, facilitating batch processing and production of primary product images.  
- **Virtual try-on creation**: In virtual try-on scenarios such as wedding photography, ethnic costumes, Hanfu, and cosplay, clothing segmentation is applied during pre-processing, followed by outfit changes via AIGC generation technology.  
- **Personalized intelligent detection**: You can request segmentation masks for specific garment categories—including outerwear, tops (including linings), pants, skirts, hats, shoes, and bags—to achieve customized foreground extraction for targeted garment types.  

## Key Advantages  
- **Multi-type auto-detection**: Automatically detects the main garments in an image without requiring manual specification of garment locations, and returns category-specific masks.  
- **Supports diverse clothing scenarios**: Suitable for fine-grained foreground extraction in scenarios involving mannequin clothing, real-person clothing, standalone clothing, and virtual human clothing.  
- **Comprehensive multi-category segmentation**: Capable of accurately segmenting multiple garment items under complex backgrounds, achieving fine-grained segmentation across all supported categories.

2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Image Segmentation service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageseg). If not yet activated, click [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageseg_public_cn#/open).

SegmentHDBody.description:
## Feature Description  
The high-definition human segmentation feature can automatically detect the human contour in an image, separate it from the background, and return a foreground portrait image after segmentation. This feature is suitable for real-person photographs and not applicable to cartoon images.  

The following figures illustrate this API's functionality:  
- Input original image  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/kgdi/SegmentHDBody.jpg" width="500)  
- Output result image  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/phjn/SegmentHDBodyjieguo.png" width="500)  

> - Compared with the human segmentation (SegmentBody) API, this API supports segmentation of higher-pixel images, with a maximum size of 40 MB.  
- You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=imageseg&children=SegmentHDBody) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  

- Portrait Photography: Human segmentation separates the main subject from the background and applies background blur to simulate a large-aperture shallow depth-of-field effect, highlighting the subject.  
- Certificate Photo Creation: Upload or capture a portrait photo, precisely segment the person, and combine it with other background processing capabilities to generate standard certificate photos.  

## Key Advantages  

- Hair-level Precision Segmentation: Achieves higher segmentation accuracy at edge details—even individual strands of hair are precisely segmented—resulting in natural-looking output that shows no visible signs of post-processing.  
- Robust Against Complex Backgrounds: Accurately segments human subjects even when they are in complex background environments.  
- Supports Multi-person Images: Works effectively for single-person, multi-person, complex backgrounds, and various human poses.  
- Supports High-resolution Images: Handles segmentation of higher-resolution images, up to a maximum size of 40 MB.  

## Integration Guide  
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com), click **Sign Up Now** in the upper-right corner, and follow the prompts to complete registration.  
2. Activate the capability: Ensure you have activated the [Image Matting service](https://vision.aliyun.com/imageseg). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_imageseg_public_cn#/open).  
3. Create an AccessKey: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. Online debugging (optional): Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/imageseg/2019-12-30/SegmentHDBody?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=dara&params=%7B%22ImageURL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Fimageseg%2FSegmentHDBody%2FSegmentHDBody1.jpg%22%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. Steps for integration:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "Image Matting (imageseg)."  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

6. Sample Code: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [High-definition Human Segmentation Sample Code](~~605134~~).  

7. Direct client invocation: Common methods for direct client-side invocation include the following:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  
- Image formats: JPG, JPEG, BMP, PNG (transparent images supported).  
- Image size: No larger than 40 MB.  
- Image resolution: Greater than 32×32 pixels and less than 6000×6000 pixels, with the longest edge no more than 6000 pixels.  
- The URL must not contain Chinese characters.
